observations.says: at nine o'clock on Tuesday night, the figure at the side door was at the side door of the surgery; from eight o'clock on Tuesday night until ten o'clock on Tuesday night, Dr. Mott was at Squire Hale's house
at nine o'clock on Tuesday night, the figure at the side door wore the long grey cloak of Dr. Mott
what she saw stands; that it was the doctor was her own conclusion, and it was wrong
from eight o'clock on Tuesday night until ten o'clock on Tuesday night, Dr. Mott wore the greatcoat of Dr. Mott; on Wednesday morning, the long grey cloak of Dr. Mott was damp
at nine o'clock on Tuesday night, the figure at the side door came out by the side door of the surgery; nobody but Dr. Mott, Mr. Pell and Kitty had a key of the side door
at nine o'clock on Tuesday night, the figure at the side door was tall; Kitty was short
